hank.name: Initial Setup
hank.promptText: List the files in <%PROJECT_DIR%>/corpus and reply with only the number of files present and the name of the first one. Do not read their contents yet.
hank.description: Rig generates the ingestion corpus deterministically; the codon just verifies it landed. Context is then filled by READING it — input/cache tokens are ~10x faster and cheaper per context-token than asking the model to WRITE essays, which is what kept the old shape of this test from ever reaching the window inside its timeout.

command.run: mkdir -p large_content && bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");fs.mkdirSync("corpus",{recursive:true});for(let f=1;f<=10;f++){let out="";for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){const n=f*100000+i;out+=`Entry ${n}: alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliett kilo lima mike november oscar papa quebec romeo sierra tango uniform victor whiskey xray yankee zulu checksum-${(n*7919)%997} tail-${n%13}\n`;}fs.writeFileSync(`corpus/part-${f}.txt`,out);}'

hank.name: Context Exhaustion Loop
hank.description: Each iteration ingests one corpus file (~50k tokens) into the continued session until the window blows. Compaction is default-OFF (intermediates/55), so the boundary arrives as the provider's real overflow rejection; terminateOn contextExceeded must then COMPLETE the loop.

codons.name: Ingest Corpus File
codons.promptText: Read the single next unread file from <%PROJECT_DIR%>/corpus/ using the Read tool. The files are part-1.txt through part-10.txt; on your first iteration read part-1.txt, next part-2.txt, and so on in order — you can tell which you have already read from the conversation so far. Read the ENTIRE file in one Read call (it is under 2000 lines). Then reply with ONLY the file name you read and the first and last Entry numbers it contains. Do not summarize, do not write files, do not read more than one file.
codons.description: Ingest one corpus file into the session

hank.name: Final Codon After Loop
hank.promptText: Create a summary file at <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/final_summary.txt with the text 'Loop completed due to context exceeded. Final codon executed successfully.'
hank.description: Runs after the loop terminates on context exceeded
